==Dialogue==
;After completing [[Kodonur Crossroads]]:
:''"Ahai, stranger. Are you here to seek [[Ascension]]? You will find it, for certain, if you listen to [[Turai Ossa|Turai]]!"''
:''"I cannot see the light anymore. Father? Father...? Can you hear me?"''
:''"Please, make the nightmares end."''
:''"Turai thought the Scriptures contained a map to enlightenment and Ascension. But they were merely lies to lure weak-minded."''
:''"Where is Turai Ossa? I followed him into the [[Crystal Desert|desert]], but the sands are so empty."''

;After completing [[Ruins of Morah]]:
:''"Be careful who you follow, traveler, for your trust may betray you."''
:''"Ossa was once a name you were proud to follow. It stood for honor and glory. Now the name is as black as coal, its honor as dead as the ash of an ancient fire."''
:''"[[Palawa Joko]]'s final curse on us was the Scriptures of [[Abaddon]]. And look what they have done to the Ossa line."''
:''"[[The Desolation]] lives up to its name. There is no hope left in our hearts."''
:''"[[Varesh Ossa]]. The name holds evil in every syllable."''

;After completing [[Abaddon's Gate]]:
:''"Ahai, traveler. I will see you in the next world."''
:''"Farewell, and cure {{sic|Should be curse}} the Ossa line! May it end with Varesh...forever!"''
:''"Farewell, stranger. There is another land I must seek, far from these desolate sands."''
:''"I see a light far to the north. Do I hear Turai's voice calling me?"''
:''"[[The Mists]] are not as distant as we had been led to believe."''
